evidence.reason: schema_problem is documented to return the first schema violation instead of raising, but the type check indexes _SCHEMA_TYPES without verifying membership. A deployment local schema rule using a valid JSON Schema type outside the small supported vocabulary, such as "number", raises KeyError and aborts receipt validation/health reporting instead of returning an invalid or unverified observation. This is an ordinary correctness defect in the intended fail-closed path; no owner decision is needed to handle unsupported type names gracefully.
